parameters.name: CurrentConnectionString
parameters.description: The current endpoint of the instance.

parameters.name: IPType
parameters.description:
The network type of the endpoint. Valid values:

*   **Private**: internal network
*   **Public**: Internet

parameters.name: NewConnectionString
parameters.description:
The prefix of the new endpoint. Specify the endpoint in the `<prefix>.redis.rds.aliyuncs.com` format. The prefix must be 8 to 40 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters and digits. It must start with a lowercase letter.

>  You must specify one of the **NewConnectionString** and **Port** parameters.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description:
The port number of the instance. Valid values: **1024** to **65535**.

>  You must specify one of the **NewConnectionString** and **Port** parameters.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore modify-db-instance-connection-string --db-instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --new-connection-string standardredis123 --current-connection-string r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000.redis.rds.aliyuncs.com --port 6379 --ip-type Public --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun r-kvstore ModifyDBInstanceConnectionString --region cn-hangzhou --IPType Public --CurrentConnectionString 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000.redis.rds.aliyuncs.com' --DBInstanceId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --Port 6379 --NewConnectionString standardredis123
